source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 21 (PDF 169-186), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 21 (Space and Environment) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 In this chapter, space refers to the region:
(Is chapter mein space se muraad kaun sa ilaqa hai?)

options.text: sirf Earth ke atmosphere ke andar
Earth ki crust aur core ke darmiyan
Earth ke atmosphere se aage jahan planets, stars aur galaxies hain

blocks.explanation: Space Earth ke atmosphere (fiza) se aage ka ilaqa hai jahan tamam celestial bodies (falaki ajsaam) maujood hain aur gravity aur electromagnetic radiations ke zariye aapas mein amal karte hain (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: Space refers to a region beyond Earth's atmosphere in which all celestial bodies

blocks.prompt:
2 Environment is described as the surrounding conditions that are:
(Environment ko kin ird-gird ke halaat ke tor par bayan kiya gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Environment (mahol) woh physical, chemical aur biological ird-gird ke halaat hain jin mein jaandaar aur bejaan nizaam maujood hain (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: Environment is the surrounding physical, chemical, and biological conditions

blocks.prompt:
3 The luminosity of a star is the:
(Kisi star ki luminosity kya hai?)

options.text: fi unit waqt electromagnetic radiation ki shakal mein kharij hone wali kul energy
Earth tak pohanchne wali fi unit area energy
Earth se nazar aane wali chamak
poori zindagi mein kharij hone wali kul energy

blocks.explanation: Luminosity star se fi unit waqt kharij hone wali kul electromagnetic energy hai (21.1).

book_ref.quote: Luminosity is the total amount of energy emitted by a star per unit time in the form of electromagnetic radiations

blocks.prompt:
4 The SI unit of luminosity is the:
(Luminosity ki SI unit kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Luminosity power hai, is liye watts mein naapi jati hai (21.1).

book_ref.quote: is measured in watts, indicating the total power of radiation emitted by a star

blocks.prompt:
5 Luminosity is the property that defines a star's:
(Luminosity star ki kaun si khasiyat ko bayan karti hai?)

options.text: Earth se nazar aane wali chamak

blocks.explanation: Luminosity woh bunyadi khasiyat hai jo star ki intrinsic (asal) chamak bayan karti hai (21.1).

book_ref.quote: It is a fundamental property that defines the intrinsic brightness of a star

blocks.prompt:
6 The luminosity of a star primarily depends on its:
(Star ki luminosity zyada tar kin cheezon par munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: Luminosity zyada tar star ke radius (nisf qutr) aur surface temperature par munhasir hai (21.1).

book_ref.quote: Luminosity of a star primarily depends on its radius and surface temperature

blocks.prompt:
7 Two stars have the same surface temperature. The larger one is more luminous because it has:
(Do stars ka surface temperature barabar hai. Bara star zyada luminous kyun hai?)

options.text: radiation kharij karne ke liye zyada surface area

blocks.explanation: Bare star ke paas radiation kharij karne ke liye zyada surface area hota hai, is liye woh zyada luminous hota hai (21.1).

book_ref.quote: Larger stars have more surface area to emit radiations and therefore, tend to be more luminous

blocks.prompt:
8 For two stars of equal size, the more luminous one is the star with the:
(Barabar size ke do stars mein zyada luminous kaun sa hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Barabar size ke stars mein zyada surface temperature wala zyada energy kharij karta hai aur zyada luminous hota hai (21.1).

book_ref.quote: for stars of equal size, the one with the higher surface temperature will radiate more energy

blocks.prompt:
9 The Stefan-Boltzmann law for a star of radius r and surface temperature T is:
(Radius r aur surface temperature T wale star ke liye Stefan-Boltzmann law kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Luminosity = surface area × radiant intensity = (4πr²)(σT⁴), Eq. (21.1).

book_ref.quote: The luminosity of a star can be represented as the product of its surface area (A=4πr²) and radiant intensity (I = σT⁴)

blocks.prompt:
10 According to the Stefan-Boltzmann law, the total output power of a star is proportional to its surface area and to:
(Stefan-Boltzmann law ke mutabiq star ki kul output power surface area ke ilawa kis cheez ke mutanasib hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kul output power surface area aur temperature ki chauthi power (T⁴) ke hasil-e-zarb ke mutanasib hai (21.1).

book_ref.quote: The total output power of a star is proportional to the product of its surface area and the fourth power of its temperature

blocks.prompt:
11 The value of the Stefan-Boltzmann constant σ is:
(Stefan-Boltzmann constant σ ki qeemat kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: σ = 5.67 × 10⁻⁸ W m⁻² K⁻⁴ (21.1). 2.9 × 10⁻³ m K Wien ka constant aur 2.3 × 10⁻¹⁸ s⁻¹ Hubble ka constant hai.

book_ref.quote: Its value is 5.67×10⁻⁸ W m⁻² K⁻⁴

blocks.prompt:
12 If the surface temperature of a star is doubled while its radius stays the same, its luminosity becomes:
(Agar star ka radius wohi rahe aur surface temperature dugna ho jaye to luminosity kitni ho jayegi?)
blocks.explanation: L ∝ T⁴, is liye L 2⁴ = 16 guna ho jati hai (21.1).

book_ref.quote: If a star becomes twice as hot, how many times more energy will it radiate?

blocks.prompt:
13 If the radius of a star is doubled at the same surface temperature, its luminosity becomes:
(Agar same surface temperature par star ka radius dugna ho jaye to luminosity kitni ho jayegi?)
blocks.explanation: Fixed T par L ∝ r², is liye L 2² = 4 guna ho jati hai (21.1).

book_ref.quote: Larger stars have more surface area to emit radiations

blocks.prompt:
14 A star has twice the radius of another star but half its surface temperature. The ratio of its luminosity to that of the other star is:
(Aik star ka radius doosre se dugna lekin surface temperature aadha hai. Us ki luminosity ka doosre star ki luminosity se ratio kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: Equation (21.1) is called Stefan-Boltzmann law

blocks.prompt:
15 The luminosity of the Sun is about:
(Suraj ki luminosity taqreeban kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Suraj ki luminosity taqreeban 4 × 10²⁶ watts hai (21.1, Tidbit).

book_ref.quote: The Sun shines with an immense luminosity of about 4×10²⁶ watts

blocks.prompt:
16 A star has radius 6.0 × 10⁸ m and surface temperature 5000 K. Its luminosity is about (σ = 5.67 × 10⁻⁸ W m⁻² K⁻⁴):
(Aik star ka radius 6.0 × 10⁸ m aur surface temperature 5000 K hai. Us ki luminosity taqreeban kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: Using Stefan-Boltzmann law; L = 4πr² σ T⁴

blocks.prompt:
17 A star of luminosity 8.0 × 10²⁶ W has a surface temperature of 7000 K. Its radius is about:
(8.0 × 10²⁶ W luminosity wale star ka surface temperature 7000 K hai. Us ka radius taqreeban kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: The luminosity of a star is given as 2.5 × 10²⁶ W

blocks.prompt:
18 Radiant flux intensity of a star is the electromagnetic energy reaching the Earth's surface:
(Star ki radiant flux intensity Earth ki surface tak pohanchne wali electromagnetic energy hai:)

options.text: fi unit area fi unit waqt
fi unit volume fi unit waqt

blocks.explanation: Radiant flux intensity star se Earth ki surface tak fi unit area fi unit waqt pohanchne wali energy hai (21.2).

book_ref.quote: Radiant flux intensity is the amount of electromagnetic energy per unit area per unit time emitted from a star

blocks.prompt:
19 The SI unit of radiant flux intensity is:
(Radiant flux intensity ki SI unit kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Radiant flux intensity fi unit area luminosity hai, is liye unit W m⁻² hai (21.2).

book_ref.quote: radiant flux intensity is the luminosity per unit area measured on the surface of Earth

blocks.prompt:
20 Compared with the luminosity of a star, the radiant flux intensity received at the Earth is:
(Star ki luminosity ke muqable mein Earth par milne wali radiant flux intensity kaisi hoti hai?)

options.text: us ka chhota sa hissa (fi square metre)

blocks.explanation: Radiant flux intensity kul luminosity ka chhota sa hissa hai (21.2).

book_ref.quote: It is a small fraction of the total value of luminosity

blocks.prompt:
21 In F = L/4πr², the quantity r is:
(F = L/4πr² mein r kya hai?)

options.text: star se naapne ki jagah tak faasla

blocks.explanation: r star se us jagah tak ka faasla hai jahan flux naapi jati hai; 4πr² us farzi sphere (kurra) ka area hai jis par luminosity phailti hai (21.2, Book correction).

book_ref.quote: In F = L/4πr², r is the distance from the star to the place where the flux is measured

blocks.prompt:
22 For a star of constant luminosity, the radiant flux intensity F varies with distance r as:
(Constant luminosity wale star ke liye radiant flux intensity F faasle r ke saath kaise badalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: F = L/4πr² aur L constant hai, is liye F inverse square law (ulta murabba qanoon) par chalti hai (21.2).

book_ref.quote: radiant flux intensity follows inverse square law with distance

blocks.prompt:
23 If the distance from a star is made four times, the radiant flux intensity becomes:
(Agar star se faasla chaar guna kar diya jaye to radiant flux intensity kitni ho jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: F ∝ 1/r², is liye 4r par flux 1/4² = 1/16 reh jati hai (21.2).

book_ref.quote: when the distance from centre of a star is doubled (from r to 2r), intensity of the radiant flux reduces to one-fourth

blocks.prompt:
24 Moving to one-third of the original distance from a star makes the radiant flux intensity:
(Star se faasla pehle ka aik tihai (1/3) kar diya jaye to radiant flux intensity kitni ho jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: F ∝ 1/r²; r/3 par flux 3² = 9 guna barh jati hai (21.2).

book_ref.quote: increasing the distance to three times its initial length (3r), decreases the flux by a factor of nine

blocks.prompt:
25 If the Earth were twice as far from the Sun, the sunlight reaching it would be:
(Agar Earth Suraj se dugne faasle par hoti to us tak pohanchne wali dhoop kitni hoti?)
blocks.explanation: Inverse square law se faasla dugna karne par intensity aik chauthai (1/4) reh jati hai (21.2, Tidbit).

book_ref.quote: If Earth were twice as far from the Sun, the sunlight reaching it would be only one-fourth as intense

blocks.prompt:
26 Two stars give the same radiant flux at Earth, but star P is 5 times farther than star Q. The luminosity of P is:
(Do stars Earth par barabar radiant flux dete hain lekin star P star Q se 5 guna door hai. P ki luminosity kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Barabar F ka matlab L ∝ r², is liye L_P/L_Q = 5² = 25 (21.2).

book_ref.quote: Two stars appear equally bright in the night sky. However, one is 10 times farther away than the other.

blocks.prompt:
27 A star of luminosity 3.0 × 10²⁶ W is 2.0 × 10¹¹ m from a planet. The radiant flux intensity at the planet is about:
(3.0 × 10²⁶ W luminosity wala star aik planet se 2.0 × 10¹¹ m door hai. Planet par radiant flux intensity taqreeban kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: The luminosity of a star is 4.50 ×10²⁶ W

blocks.prompt:
28 The radiant flux from a star of luminosity 2.0 × 10²⁶ W is 500 W m⁻² at a planet. The distance of the planet from the star is about:
(2.0 × 10²⁶ W luminosity wale star ki radiant flux aik planet par 500 W m⁻² hai. Planet ka star se faasla taqreeban kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: Radiant flux intensity from a star at a distance d is expressed as:

blocks.prompt:
29 The idea of standard candles began with the discovery that Cepheid variable stars:
(Standard candles ka khayal is daryaft se shuru hua ke Cepheid variable stars:)

options.text: aik maloom (predictable) tareeqe se pulse karte hain

blocks.explanation: 1910s mein Henrietta Swan Leavitt ne daryaft kiya ke Cepheid variable stars aik maloom tareeqe se pulse (dharakna) karte hain (21.2, Do you know?).

book_ref.quote: Henrietta Swan Leavitt discovered that Cepheid variable stars pulse in a predictable way

blocks.prompt:
30 A standard candle is an astronomical object whose:
(Standard candle aisa falaki jism hai jis ki:)
blocks.explanation: Standard candles woh falaki ajsaam hain jin ki intrinsic (asal) chamak maloom hoti hai; in se kaainati faasle naape jate hain (21.3).

book_ref.quote: The standard candles are astronomical objects with known intrinsic brightness

blocks.prompt:
31 Comparing the known true brightness of a standard candle with its apparent brightness, astronomers find its distance using the:
(Standard candle ki maloom asal chamak ka zahiri chamak se muqabla kar ke astronomers faasla kis qanoon se nikalte hain?)

options.text: angular momentum ki conservation ka qanoon

blocks.explanation: Zahiri chamak ka asal chamak se muqabla kar ke light ke inverse-square law se faasla nikalta hai (21.3).

book_ref.quote: astronomers can calculate its distance using the inverse-square law of light

blocks.prompt:
32 Which pair are examples of standard candles?
(Kaun sa jora standard candles ki misal hai?)

options.text: Cepheid variable stars aur Type Ia supernovae

blocks.explanation: Standard candles ki misalein Cepheid variable stars aur Type Ia supernovae hain (21.3).

book_ref.quote: Examples of standard candles are Cepheid variable stars and Type Ia supernovae

blocks.prompt:
33 Cepheid variables and Type Ia supernovae are reliable distance indicators because they have:
(Cepheid variables aur Type Ia supernovae faasle ke qabil-e-aitbaar nishan kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Dono ki luminosities pehle se maloom (predictable) hoti hain, is liye yeh faasle ke qabil-e-aitbaar nishan hain (21.3).

book_ref.quote: both of which have predictable luminosities that make them reliable distance indicators

blocks.prompt:
34 How bright a standard candle appears from the Earth is called its:
(Standard candle Earth se jitna chamakdar nazar aata hai use kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Standard candle Earth se jitna chamakdar nazar aaye use apparent magnitude (zahiri chamak) kehte hain (21.3).

book_ref.quote: By comparing how bright a standard candle appears from the Earth (apparent magnitude)

blocks.prompt:
35 A Type Ia supernova of luminosity 5.0 × 10³⁵ W gives a flux of 1.0 × 10⁻¹¹ W m⁻² at the Earth. Its distance is about:
(5.0 × 10³⁵ W luminosity wala Type Ia supernova Earth par 1.0 × 10⁻¹¹ W m⁻² flux deta hai. Us ka faasla taqreeban kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: measuring the distances to stars and galaxies is essential for understanding the structure and expansion of the universe

blocks.prompt:
36 Stars such as the Sun behave like:
(Suraj jaise stars kis cheez ki tarah bartao karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Suraj jaise stars blackbody radiators ki tarah bartao karte hain (21.4).

book_ref.quote: Stars such as Sun behave like blackbody radiator

blocks.prompt:
37 Stars generate their own energy due to:
(Stars apni energy kis wajah se paida karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Stars apni energy nuclear fusion (markazi milaap) se paida aur kharij karte hain (21.4).

book_ref.quote: They generate and emit their own energy due to nuclear fusion

blocks.prompt:
38 The radiation emitted by a star covers a wide range of wavelengths and forms a:
(Star ki radiation bohat si wavelengths par phaili hoti hai aur kya banati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Star ki radiation baghair khala ke continuous spectrum (musalsal tarteeb) banati hai jo blackbody spectrum jaisa hai (21.4).

book_ref.quote: forms a continuous spectrum without any gaps

blocks.prompt:
39 By studying the spectrum of a star, scientists can accurately estimate its:
(Star ka spectrum parh kar scientists us ki kaun si cheez durust andaza kar sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Spectrum parh kar scientists star ka surface temperature durust andaza kar sakte hain (21.4).

book_ref.quote: By studying the spectrum, scientists can estimate the surface temperature of the star accurately

blocks.prompt:
40 According to Wien's displacement law, λmax of a blackbody is:
(Wien's displacement law ke mutabiq blackbody ki λmax:)
blocks.explanation: λmax ∝ 1/T, yani λmax T = b (21.4, Eq. 21.3).

book_ref.quote: The wavelength corresponding to the radiation of maximum intensity emitted by a blackbody is inversely proportional to its surface temperature

blocks.prompt:
41 The value of Wien's constant b is:
(Wien ke constant b ki qeemat kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Wien ka constant b = 2.9 × 10⁻³ m K (21.4).

book_ref.quote: where b is a constant called Wien's constant whose value is 2.9 × 10⁻³ mK

blocks.prompt:
42 As the temperature of a blackbody increases, its λmax:
(Blackbody ka temperature barhne se us ki λmax:)

options.text: lambi wavelengths ki taraf khisakti hai
chhoti wavelengths ki taraf khisakti hai

blocks.explanation: T barhne se λmax chhoti wavelengths ki taraf khisak jati hai (21.4).

book_ref.quote: as the temperature of a blackbody increases, the maximum wavelength of its emitted radiation shifts towards shorter values

blocks.prompt:
43 A star that appears blue or violet compared with a red star is:
(Surkh star ke muqable mein neela ya banafshi nazar aane wala star:)
blocks.explanation: Zyada garam ajsaam chhoti wavelengths (neeli ya banafshi) kharij karte hain; thande surkh nazar aate hain (21.4).

book_ref.quote: hotter objects emit radiation with shorter wavelengths (appearing blue or violet)

blocks.prompt:
44 Cooler objects emit radiation of maximum intensity at:
(Thande ajsaam maximum intensity wali radiation kahan kharij karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Thande ajsaam lambi wavelengths (surkh ya infrared) par radiation kharij karte hain (21.4).

book_ref.quote: cooler objects emit radiation with longer wavelengths (appearing red or infrared)

blocks.prompt:
45 Star A has a shorter peak wavelength than star B. Therefore star A:
(Star A ki peak wavelength star B se chhoti hai. Is liye star A:)
blocks.explanation: λmax ∝ 1/T, is liye chhoti peak wavelength ka matlab zyada surface temperature hai (21.4).

book_ref.quote: If a star's peak wavelength is shorter, what does that tell us about its temperature?

blocks.prompt:
46 The peak wavelength of radiation from a star is 400 nm. Its surface temperature is about (b = 2.9 × 10⁻³ m K):
(Aik star ki radiation ki peak wavelength 400 nm hai. Us ka surface temperature taqreeban kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: This shift explains the change in colour of heated objects

blocks.prompt:
47 A star has a surface temperature of 10000 K. Its peak wavelength is (b = 2.9 × 10⁻³ m K):
(Aik star ka surface temperature 10000 K hai. Us ki peak wavelength kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: Wien's Displacement law describes the relationship between the surface temperature T of a blackbody

blocks.prompt:
48 Star 1 at 5000 K has peak wavelength 600 nm. Star 2 has peak wavelength 400 nm. The temperature of star 2 is:
(5000 K wale star 1 ki peak wavelength 600 nm hai. Star 2 ki peak wavelength 400 nm hai. Star 2 ka temperature kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: Another star has a peak wavelength of 320 nm

blocks.prompt:
49 If the absolute temperature of a blackbody is tripled, its λmax becomes:
(Agar blackbody ka absolute temperature teen guna ho jaye to us ki λmax kitni ho jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: λmax T = constant, is liye T teen guna hone par λmax aik tihai (1/3) reh jati hai (21.4).

book_ref.quote: In simple words, hotter objects emit radiation

blocks.prompt:
50 By studying the emission and absorption spectra of a star, scientists can find:
(Star ke emission aur absorption spectra parh kar scientists kya maloom kar sakte hain?)

options.text: kaainat ki umar seedhe tor par
star kin elements se bana hai

blocks.explanation: Har star ki apni light signature hoti hai; spectra se pata chalta hai ke star kin elements (anaasir) se bana hai (21.4, Tidbit).

book_ref.quote: by studying the emission and absorption spectra, scientists can determine what elements a star is made of

blocks.prompt:
51 The radiation from a heated (ideal) glowing body depends only on its:
(Garam chamakte (ideal) jism ki radiation sirf kis cheez par munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh radiation sirf jism ke temperature par munhasir hai, us ke material ya shakal par nahi (21.4).

book_ref.quote: This radiation depends only on the temperature of the object, not on its material or shape

blocks.prompt:
52 As an object is heated more and more, its colour changes in the order:
(Jism ko zyada se zyada garam karne par us ka rang kis tarteeb se badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Temperature barhne se rang halka surkh → chamakdar peela → safaid ho jata hai (21.4).

book_ref.quote: the colour of the object changes from dull red to bright yellow and then to white

blocks.prompt:
53 A blackbody is a body that:
(Blackbody aisa jism hai jo:)

options.text: sirf aik wavelength kharij karta hai
tamam radiation guzar jane deta hai
tamam radiation jazb karta aur har wavelength par mukammal kharij karta hai

blocks.explanation: Blackbody apne upar girne wali tamam radiation jazb karta hai aur tamam wavelengths par mukammal radiation kharij karta hai (21.4).

book_ref.quote: A blackbody is one that absorbs all the radiations falling on it and also emits radiations at all wavelengths perfectly

blocks.prompt:
54 Scientists use the idea of an ideal blackbody because real objects:
(Scientists ideal blackbody ka tasawwur kyun istemal karte hain?)

options.text: haqeeqi ajsaam sab radiation mukammal jazb karte hain
haqeeqi ajsaam koi radiation kharij nahi karte
haqeeqi ajsaam tamam radiation poori jazb ya kharij nahi karte
haqeeqi ajsaam sirf visible light kharij karte hain

blocks.explanation: Haqeeqi ajsaam tamam radiation poori tarah jazb ya kharij nahi karte, is liye un ka mutala mushkil hai (21.4).

book_ref.quote: real objects do not absorb or emit all the radiation completely

blocks.prompt:
55 A good practical example of a blackbody is:
(Blackbody ki achi amli misal kya hai?)

options.text: chhote surakh aur kaali andaruni deewaron wala khokhla cavity

blocks.explanation: Chhote surakh aur kaali andaruni deewaron wala khokhla cavity blackbody ki achi misal hai (21.4, Fig. 21.3).

book_ref.quote: a good example of a blackbody is a hollow cavity with a small hole and blackened inner walls

blocks.prompt:
56 The inner walls of a blackbody cavity are coated with:
(Blackbody cavity ki andaruni deewaron par kya lagaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Andaruni deewaron par kaali carbon soot (kaalak) lagai jati hai taake radiation achi tarah jazb ho (21.4).

book_ref.quote: coated with black carbon soot to help them absorb radiation effectively

blocks.prompt:
57 Radiation entering the small hole of the cavity is absorbed because it:
(Cavity ke chhote surakh se dakhil hone wali radiation kyun jazb ho jati hai?)

options.text: andar takra takra kar phans jati hai
doosri taraf se seedhi nikal jati hai
foran surakh se wapas reflect ho jati hai

blocks.explanation: Chhote surakh se dakhil radiation andar baar baar takra kar phans jati hai (21.4).

book_ref.quote: When radiation enters through the small hole, it bounces around inside and gets trapped

blocks.prompt:
58 When the cavity is heated to a high enough temperature, the radiation it emits is called:
(Cavity ko kaafi zyada garam karne par jo radiation nikalti hai use kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Garam cavity tamam wavelengths ki radiation kharij karti hai; ise blackbody radiation kehte hain (21.4).

book_ref.quote: If the cavity is heated to a high enough temperature, it starts to emit radiation of all wavelengths

blocks.prompt:
59 On a graph of intensity against wavelength for a blackbody, raising the temperature:
(Blackbody ke intensity aur wavelength ke graph par temperature barhane se:)

options.text: curve neecha hota hai aur peak lambi wavelength ki taraf jati hai
curve ooncha hota hai aur peak chhoti wavelength ki taraf jati hai
curve seedhi line ban jata hai

blocks.explanation: Temperature barhne se kharij energy barhti hai aur peak chhoti wavelengths ki taraf khisakti hai (21.4, Fig. 21.4).

book_ref.quote: the peak of the curve shifts to shorter wavelengths with rising temperature

blocks.prompt:
60 By Wien's law, the peak of the 2000 K blackbody curve lies at about:
(Wien's law se 2000 K blackbody curve ki peak taqreeban kahan hai?)

book_ref.quote: the peaks lie at about 0.58, 0.72, 0.97 and 1.45 μm for 5000, 4000, 3000 and 2000 K

blocks.prompt:
61 Which of the following has an almost perfect blackbody spectrum?
(Kis cheez ka spectrum taqreeban mukammal blackbody spectrum hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cosmic microwave background radiation ka spectrum taqreeban mukammal blackbody hai; microwave oven ka magnetron blackbody source nahi (21.4, Book correction).

book_ref.quote: It is the cosmic microwave background radiation that has an almost perfect blackbody spectrum

blocks.prompt:
62 Of two heated objects, one glows red-hot and the other white-hot. The hotter one is:
(Do garam ajsaam mein aik surkh garam aur doosra safaid garam chamakta hai. Zyada garam kaun sa hai?)

options.text: rang se nahi bataya ja sakta

blocks.explanation: Temperature barhne se rang surkh → peela → safaid hota hai, is liye safaid garam jism zyada garam hai (21.4).

book_ref.quote: One glows red-hot, and the other glows white-hot

blocks.prompt:
63 The radius of a star is calculated by using:
(Star ka radius kin qawaneen se nikala jata hai?)

options.text: Wien's displacement law aur Stefan-Boltzmann law

blocks.explanation: Star ka radius Wien's displacement law aur Stefan-Boltzmann law se nikala ja sakta hai (21.5).

book_ref.quote: The radius of a star can be calculated using Wien's displacement law and the Stefan-Boltzmann law

blocks.prompt:
64 In finding a star's radius, the first step is to find its surface temperature from:
(Star ka radius nikalne mein pehle surface temperature kis se maloom kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pehle surface temperature T Wien's displacement law (λmax se) se maloom kiya jata hai (21.5).

book_ref.quote: the surface temperature T of a star is first determined using Wien's displacement law

blocks.prompt:
65 In finding a star's radius, its luminosity is obtained from the:
(Star ka radius nikalte waqt us ki luminosity kis se hasil ki jati hai?)

options.text: Earth par naapi gayi radiant flux intensity aur faasla

blocks.explanation: Luminosity radiant flux intensity aur faasle se (L = 4πd²F) nikali jati hai (21.5).

book_ref.quote: The Luminosity of a star can be calculated using the radiant flux intensity

blocks.prompt:

blocks.prompt:
130 The Coriolis deflection of moving air:
(Harkat karti hawa par Coriolis deflection ka kya asar hai?)

options.text: har ghante hawa ulat deta hai

blocks.explanation: Yeh murna hawa ki speed nahi badalta balke us ka raasta badalta hai aur khamdar hawa ke patterns banata hai (21.12).

book_ref.quote: This deflection does not affect the speed of the air but changes its path

blocks.prompt:
131 The three atmospheric circulation cells in each hemisphere are:
(Har hemisphere mein teen atmospheric circulation cells kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mure hue hawa ke bahao har hemisphere mein teen cells banate hain: Hadley, Ferrel aur Polar cell (21.12, Fig. 21.14).

book_ref.quote: the Hadley cell, Ferrel cell, and Polar cell

blocks.prompt:
132 Air moving from the equator toward a pole keeps rv constant. Compared with the ground beneath it, it:
(Equator se pole ki taraf jati hawa rv constant rakhti hai. Neeche ki zameen ke muqable mein woh:)

options.text: mashriq ki taraf tez chal kar aage nikal jati hai
bilkul barabar speed se chalti hai

blocks.explanation: r kam hota hai to v barhti hai; oonche latitude par zameen ahista ghoomti hai, is liye yeh hawa aage nikal jati hai (mashriq ki taraf murti hai). Pole se equator jane wali hawa peeche reh jati hai (21.12, Book correction).

book_ref.quote: It is air moving from a pole toward the equator that lags behind the faster-moving surface

blocks.text: 21.13 Role of Salt and Density in Ocean Circulation

blocks.prompt:
133 The amount of salt in ocean water is called:
(Samandari paani mein namak ki miqdaar ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Samandari paani mein namak ki miqdaar ko salinity (namkeeni) kehte hain (21.13).

book_ref.quote: The amount of salt in ocean water is called salinity

blocks.prompt:
134 Salty water is denser because dissolved salt:
(Namkeen paani zyada ghana (dense) kyun hota hai?)

options.text: mass barhata hai magar volume khaas nahi barhta

blocks.explanation: Hal shuda namak paani ka mass barhata hai magar volume khaas nahi barhta, is liye density barhti hai (21.13).

book_ref.quote: the dissolved salt increases the mass of the water without significantly increasing its volume

blocks.prompt:
135 Which seawater is the densest?
(Kaun sa samandari paani sab se zyada ghana (dense) hai?)
blocks.explanation: Thanda paani garam se aur namkeen paani kam namkeen se ghana hai, is liye thanda namkeen paani sab se ghana hai (21.13).

book_ref.quote: Cold water is denser than warm water, and salty water is denser than less salty water

blocks.prompt:
136 Surface waters become colder and saltier and sink, often due to:
(Surface ka paani thanda aur namkeen ho kar kis wajah se doob jata hai?)

options.text: evaporation ya samandari barf ka banna

blocks.explanation: Surface ka paani evaporation (bukharat) ya samandari barf banne se thanda aur namkeen ho kar ghana hota aur doob jata hai (21.13).

book_ref.quote: When surface waters become colder and saltier often due to evaporation or the formation of sea ice

blocks.prompt:
137 Deep ocean circulation transports around the globe:
(Gehri samandari gardish duniya bhar mein kya muntaqil karti hai?)

options.text: heat aur gases jaise oxygen aur carbon dioxide

blocks.explanation: Gehri gardish heat aur gases (oxygen aur carbon dioxide) duniya bhar mein le jati hai (21.13).

book_ref.quote: This deep circulation helps transport heat, and gases (such as oxygen and carbon dioxide)

blocks.prompt:
138 Thermohaline circulation is often called the:
(Thermohaline circulation ko aksar kya kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Thermohaline circulation ko aksar global conveyor belt kaha jata hai (21.14).

book_ref.quote: often referred to as the global conveyor belt

blocks.prompt:
139 Thermohaline circulation is driven by variations in:
(Thermohaline circulation kin cheezon ke farq se chalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh paani ke temperature aur salinity ke farq se chalti hai jo mil kar density par asar dalte hain (21.14).

book_ref.quote: This circulation is driven by variations in water temperature and salinity

blocks.prompt:
140 In thermohaline circulation, warm, less dense water near the equator:
(Thermohaline circulation mein equator ke qareeb garam, kam ghana paani:)

options.text: samandar ki tah par poles ki taraf jata hai
surface par poles ki taraf jata hai

blocks.explanation: Equator ke qareeb garam kam ghana paani surface par poles ki taraf heat le kar jata hai (21.14).

book_ref.quote: Warm, less dense water near the equator moves along the surface toward the polar regions

blocks.prompt:
141 In polar areas, water sinks in thermohaline circulation because:
(Thermohaline circulation mein polar ilaqon mein paani kyun doobta hai?)

options.text: thanda hota hai aur barf banne se salinity barhti hai, is liye ghana ho jata hai
garam ho kar kam ghana ho jata hai

blocks.explanation: Polar ilaqon mein paani thanda hota hai aur samandari barf banne se salinity barhti hai, ghana ho kar doob jata hai (21.14).

book_ref.quote: increased salinity from sea ice formation, causing it to sink

blocks.prompt:
142 One full cycle of the global conveyor belt takes approximately:
(Global conveyor belt ka aik poora chakkar taqreeban kitna waqt leta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Global conveyor belt ko tamam samandari basins mein paani ghumane mein taqreeban 1,000 saal lagte hain (21.14).

book_ref.quote: takes approximately 1,000 years to cycle water

blocks.prompt:
143 In the figure of thermohaline circulation, the red ribbons represent:
(Thermohaline circulation ki figure mein surkh ribbons kya zahir karte hain?)

options.text: poles ki taraf behti garam surface currents

blocks.explanation: Garam surface currents (surkh ribbons) poles ki taraf behti hain; doobta thanda paani neele ribbons se dikhaya gaya hai (21.14, Fig. 21.15).

book_ref.quote: warm surface currents (represented by red ribbons) flow poleward

blocks.prompt:
144 According to the chapter, if global warming slows down thermohaline circulation:
(Chapter ke mutabiq agar global warming thermohaline circulation ko ahista kar de to:)

options.text: Europe ko chhota ice age pesh aa sakta hai

blocks.explanation: Agar global warming ise ahista kar de to Europe ko chhota ice age pesh aa sakta hai jabke baqi duniya garam ho rahi ho (21.14, Tidbit).

book_ref.quote: If global warming slows it down, Europe could face a mini-ice age
